get.description: Content-free live snapshot or retained Activity page when limit is set. from/to/principal/result are available ONLY for retained kind=exchange. They filter the stored settlement history, not the live ring or MCP history. Cursors are scoped to Workspace and evidence kind, not to filters. Absence does not prove an execution never occurred.

200.description: Live local Node observation; Cache-Control: no-store

get.description: Download a bounded retained Activity slice as NDJSON or CSV. Requires one kind (exchange or mcp_operation); up to 2000 rows, 8 MiB and 30 seconds per response. Export is content-free retained evidence, not a complete execution audit or a transactionally consistent database snapshot. Repeat with X-Swobu-Next-Cursor until absent. from/to/principal/result apply to exchange only.

schema.description: One tagged, redacted exchange or MCP operation JSON object per line.
Fixed-schema CSV with spreadsheet formula-safe textual values.

X-Swobu-Export-Rows.description: Number of records in this response.

X-Swobu-Next-Cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same Workspace and kind.

get.description: Content-free causal evidence and separate upstream/client outcomes for one exact operation. Counts describe recorded invocations, not proof against unrecorded execution or permission to retry. A 404 means unavailable evidence, not confirmed absence or failure.
